semantic_review_dispositions.rationale: Rectangle-diagonal geometry versus magnetic-pole physics; unrelated despite generic shared wording.
Esterification of ethanol and ethanoic acid versus addition of bromine to ethene; different reactants, reaction type and product.
Definition of a dominant allele versus identifying a heterozygous genotype; related genetics but distinct learning outcomes.
Elegy as a poetic form versus biography as a life account; distinct literary forms.
Radiation through a vacuum versus convection in fluids; different heat-transfer mechanisms.
Deflation versus inflation; opposite movements in the general price level, not duplicate concepts.
Separating immiscible liquids with a separating funnel versus separating an insoluble solid from a liquid; different separation procedures.
Auxin and shoot elongation versus metallic properties; unrelated subjects, lexical false positive.
Plasma transport of dissolved substances versus haemoglobin transport of oxygen; distinct blood components and functions.
Euphemism versus oxymoron; different figures of speech.
Possessive relative pronoun 'whose' versus a relative clause; different grammatical functions.
Plural-only noun 'cattle' taking a plural verb versus singular head noun 'list'; distinct concord rules.
A party constitution governing internal rules versus a manifesto presenting policies; distinct political documents.
